svg.title: A pocket-sized snow village — step 3: Give each roof its character
svg.desc: For a cottage, lay short twigs on the snowy roof slopes and dust them lightly with snow. For round houses, tuck an already-loose evergreen sprig or dry stem into each top. For a castle, shape low snow turrets. Let the solid snow support the details and keep rocks at ground level.
